Step into this modern 4-room shared apartment, thoughtfully designed for communal living. Here, you'll find everything you need for a comfortable and harmonious cohabitation experience.

The Apartment
Freshly renovated, the entire space boasts stylish furnishings, with modern pieces carefully selected to create an inviting atmosphere.

Kitchen:
The highlight of the apartment is the new, fully equipped kitchen. You'll find everything from cutlery to glasses and modern appliances, perfect for sociable cooking evenings and unforgettable shared meals!

Bathroom:
Compact yet highly functional, the bathroom features a refreshing shower that adds an extra touch of comfort.

Dining Area:
An inviting dining area encourages you to share meals and exchange daily experiences, while a spacious hallway fosters a friendly and open ambiance, making the living space even more welcoming. This apartment is ideal for students and young professionals who value a modern, communal environment.

The Room
Your room offers approximately 15 square meters of generous space, flooded with natural light from two large windows. It comes furnished with a comfortable 140x200 cm bed, a practical desk, and a stylish dresser, providing ample storage alongside the wardrobe.

Location
Geroldseckstraße 16 is nestled in a quiet and friendly residential neighborhood in the Hadern district—perfect for students and young professionals seeking an inspiring and pleasant lifestyle.

Shopping Options:
You'll find numerous shopping opportunities nearby, including supermarkets like Edeka and Rewe, as well as bakeries, cozy cafés, and small shops. The nearby Haderner Stern also offers a great selection of stores and restaurants—ideal for a quick meal or your daily needs.

Public Transport:
Public transport connections are excellent. The Hadern U-Bahn station (U6) is just a short walk away, providing swift access to the city center and key universities and colleges in Munich. Several nearby bus lines add further flexibility for your daily commutes.

Leisure Activities
Hadern offers a wealth of recreational opportunities for an active lifestyle. The surrounding parks and green spaces invite you to relax, jog, or engage in shared activities with friends. The nearby Forstenrieder Park is perfect for outdoor adventures, providing a wonderful retreat in nature.

Educational Institutions and Job Opportunities
This location is particularly advantageous for students and young professionals, with numerous schools, universities, and colleges in the area. Additionally, many companies and start-ups nearby offer exciting internships and job opportunities.

Overall, Geroldseckstraße 16 combines tranquility and quality of life with the vibrancy of urban living. This apartment is ideal for anyone seeking an inspiring environment for their studies and career!

As landlords, we prioritize creating a harmonious and inviting atmosphere for all our residents. We carefully ensure that our tenants are compatible, fostering pleasant and peaceful coexistence.

Each of our rooms is designed for maximum comfort and is perfect for those who work from home. With high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the apartment, you’ll enjoy seamless connectivity for all your professional and personal needs—whether joining video calls, studying, or streaming your favorite shows.

We believe that living here is more than just having a room—it’s about being part of a welcoming community where everyone feels at home. If you’re looking for a vibrant environment that supports your lifestyle, come check out Geroldseckstraße 16!

title: Am Langwieder Bach, Munich
description:
Beautiful room in a historic, 150+ years old house with 100 sqm. 10 walking minutes from the next S-Bahn Station, 3 walking minutes from the next bus station.
Total of 4 bed rooms, own private garden, all renovated in 2023 with charming and functional details like new kitchen, authentic furniture partly from the 60's to today and more.
Room fully equipped incl. TV, and you can use the shared rooms like kitchen, 1 bathroom with shower & bathtub,  2 seperate toilets, 1 separate shower, washing machine, dryer, fully equipped kitchen including induction hob, oven, microwave, dish washer and large fridge/ freezer combo. You also have access to the Starlink Internet access of the house.
You have access to the shared private garden, as well as to a shared storage room.
Please note: this room currently has only a folding door, but can be locked with lock & key which are provided.
Photos were taken during the last phase of renovation, so there might be some minor changes and modernisations.

title: Radolfzeller Straße, Munich
description:
Room Description
This cozy and modern private room offers a generous common area. The room is elegantly furnished with a comfortable bed, a large wardrobe, and a desk, providing ample space for both relaxation and productivity. Our shared apartments are the perfect opportunity for “newcomers” to Munich to quickly find their footing and build meaningful connections. Here, you’ll find not just a place to stay, but also a welcoming and vibrant community to be part of. Thanks to the relaxed and friendly atmosphere in our shared flats, settling in feels effortless. In our experience, everyone quickly finds their place—whether you’re new to the city or simply looking for a fresh start. We, as landlords, highly value respectful and considerate interactions among roommates—because a harmonious living environment is what truly makes shared living enjoyable!

Common Areas
The apartment was recently renovated and shines with a modern and fresh design. It features a stylish bathroom with high-quality, contemporary tiles that create a welcoming atmosphere. The built-in kitchen is fully equipped with everything needed for cooking and dining: a refrigerator, freezer, stovetop, oven, sink, dishwasher, and washing machine. This combination of comfort, style, and modern amenities makes living in this apartment particularly enjoyable and ensures a smooth daily routine.

The apartment is located in a peaceful area of Munich. The neighborhood offers excellent public transportation options, making it easy to explore the city and access various local amenities.
